query: Based on the conversations, how do members of the group position themselves on using AI-based image enhancement tools like BlurXTerminator?
gold: Felix automates BlurXTerminator as step 4 of his 12-step processing macro. Marcus uses it selectively — yes on stars, no on nebulosity. Aida uses BlurXTerminator on stars but has stopped using NoiseXTerminator after a comparison favored traditional masked stretch. Lena uses BlurXTerminator sparingly, always with a disclaimer, after seeing a published blind comparison. Esme followed Lena's update and adopted the same disclaimer-first practice. Ravi outright refuses and Otis sides with Ravi. Other members are not clearly positioned on this axis from the conversation.
context:

[2] (about=Lena, episodic, t12 @2025-04-14T20:08:00) Maya, this is a topic I have changed my view on recently. I have been openly critical of the AI tools. After seeing a careful blind comparison published last month showing minimal hallucination on resolved sources, I have started using BlurXTerminator on my own data with a disclaimer in the caption. So: not a cheat, but document its use.
[3] (about=Aida, episodic, t12 @2025-04-14T20:24:00) I've stopped using NoiseXTerminator after a careful comparison with traditional masked stretch. The traditional approach gave me cleaner background noise statistics. BlurX I still use for stars.

[7] (about=Marcus, episodic, t12 @2025-04-14T20:16:00) I use BlurX selectively. Stars yes; nebulosity no. The risk-reward calculation differs by structure.

agent_answer:

- **All others (Boris, Camila, Clara, Diego, Esme, Felix, Ines, Jonas, Luc, Mei, Nia, Otis, Priya, Rafiq, Ravi, Saira, Sven, Theo, Yara)** – No recorded position on this matter.
